Part of #237. Owner product acceptance and closure remain open on that issue.

Delayed saves and publish replies now reconcile against the accepted draft and the exact immutable version stored. A publish attempt preserves newer device edits, rechecks held input and conflicts before dispatch, and reads the server before retrying an uncertain request. A divergent readback sends no POST and enters the existing Reload server draft / Overwrite with this copy recovery.

Messages distinguish an earlier uncertain request from the current click and describe the named version's contents. Publication cancels other loops' in-flight validation before marking it stale for next use; the publishing loop's own checks remain intact.

## Current integration and gates

Head `30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348`, tree `6cdf7c4369ae3494bafddaa6f9f83cf9335f2029`, targets actual main `8fadcb0d44ac2caf80ff6279fe4648ce9398afd9` after parent #474 merged. Source freeze `da1681e4` merges the corrected child `35bb3fbd` with that main. All 27 combined product paths and 19,980 inherited QA blobs were checked; the shared store adds only two inherited comments. Integration verification passed 173 tests across 12 files, no-emit types, scoped lint and affected documentation formatting. [Integration evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-actual-main-integration/README.md)

The first publication added 201 reviewed evidence files plus delivery metadata. This final publication adds the actual-main native packet: 107 files (1,605,879 bytes) plus register and QA attributes, with all 109 staged and committed blobs verified. Product, tests and build inputs are unchanged after the source freeze.

Fresh native QA at the tested ancestor head `bf9f287652a23177b87488df110dfd6147acaad0` passed all 19 outcomes on their first execution across 14 isolated fixtures, with no driver corrections or page errors. All 49 source paths, 17 embedded modules and 1,227 compiled files matched before/after; served assets and cleanup passed. Root read the full report and inspected three screenshots. [Final native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-final-main-native/README.md)

This final correction adds the missing final newline to the authored integration README and refreshes its wrapper manifest/checksums. All raw evidence remains unchanged; the complete repository format check passed locally. The earlier format-gate failure is retained. No product, test or build input changed, so the native source binding remains exact.

Current-target CI runs 43657427543 and 43657427557 passed all five jobs on their first attempts. Their actual checkout was merge `a283b790836207b23e3126d6f794f78433334d3b`, with parents `8fadcb0d` and `30b24ce3`; its tree exactly matches this PR head. Gates passed 22 coverage tasks (web 2,598 tests/210 files; domain 459/29), Browser passed 479 with one expected live-provider skip and no retries, Windows passed 14/14, and template image and routing passed. The configured high audit threshold passed with eight low and thirteen moderate advisories. All raw logs and exact identity readbacks are retained.

The earlier bf9f checks ran against the old parent before retargeting; the later 1867 checks used main but failed on the authored README's missing final newline. Their original failures and canceled browser runs remain retained. This head corrects that wrapper only and has fresh successful current-target checks.

Fresh whole-PR GPT-6 Astra max audit SIGNED OFF on this exact head/tree against actual main as scan 2 of the three-total cap. The orchestrator read the full report and accepts the verdict: all four original findings are resolved, with no new admitted findings or deferrals. [Full audit and root disposition](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/475#issuecomment-6887049928). Two scans were consumed; the third is unused. Engineering gates are complete. Owner acceptance remains open on #237.

## Review and retained verification

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh corrected all four findings from [formal scan 1 and root dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/475#issuecomment-6882651485). The original change-required report is retained; none of those findings is deferred.

- Original source failed 20 of the 52 final focused tests with 32 passing controls. Corrected source passed all 52 and 284 related tests, plus types, lint and formatting. [Source correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-review-correction/README.md)
- Independent native QA reproduced the designated historical negative schedules using Edge, the compiled gateway and file SQLite. [Historical negatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-review-historical-native/README.md)
- The corrected `35bb3fbd` stack passed all ten correction cases, four publication/version-pin outcomes, three save/list/detail outcomes and two uncertainty controls. Exact public/device graphs, tokens, immutable v1/v2 and wire chronology were checked. All 37 source blobs, nine embedded modules and 1,227 artifacts matched before/after; all 14 gateway/Edge fixtures closed cleanly. These remain historical stack results; the fresh actual-main run is recorded above. [Corrected native QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-review-corrected-native/README.md)
- Corrected-stack CI 43634737570 and routing 43634737582 passed all five jobs first attempt: 22 coverage tasks, web 2,572 tests/206 files, domain 452/29, Browser 479 plus one expected live-provider skip with no retries, Windows 14/14 and template image. Eight low and thirteen moderate dependency advisories remain recorded; the configured high threshold passed. [Stack CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-correction-ci/README.md)
- Parent #474 completed under the documented D-035/D-042 three-scan cap after known-cause corrections, independent native verification and all five current-head CI jobs passed. Its historical negative Astra report remains unchanged; no fourth scan or renewed Astra sign-off is claimed. [Parent completion](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-final-completion/README.md)

Earlier implementation, original CI/native results and first fixture failures remain linked from the [publication index](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/30b24ce35d9bcc247579acf54d4efb8153ca0348/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-publication/README.md). They do not substitute for current-head gates.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the actual merged build and observations on #237. Confirm that saved/published and later-edit notices are understandable, refusal and recovery wording makes the available copies clear, and navigation/list updates feel trustworthy. Machine-checkable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility. No owner instance/store change, migration or owner acceptance is claimed.

Parent #273 delivery, current CI, independent GPT review and fresh Astra max audit remain pending; formal scans are 0/3. This issue remains open for owner product acceptance and closure.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh implemented the UI. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh native QA passed both uncertain-outcome variants and 17 scenarios across publication, transport, list/detail, token ancestry and refusals on `8fe52989`, using actual Edge, compiled API main and disposable SQLite. Before/after 29-source and 1,227-build-file bindings matched, zero uncaught page errors occurred, and all 12 fixture instances were cleaned up. Two earlier independently found retry defects, effective negative controls and original fixture failures remain retained. The final correction passed 33 publish tests and 262 affected tests; historical coverage and current CI are separate.

[Evidence index](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-publication/README.md) · [Independent native QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-independent-corrected-native/README.md) · [Current CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43625241660). The later commits add evidence, guide clarification, raw-TSX formatting preservation and parent documentation; runtime/test code matches the observed candidate. Same-mounted recovery's older pending label was observed while the loop queue prevented the restored draft's save; after settlement it saved and published correctly. This is not a confirmed block of independently acknowledged newer work.

Earlier GPT frontend proposals are unaccepted inputs for Claude to assess and own, not completed UI delivery. <!-- graphgoblin-approved-revision:2026-10-18 -->

**Owner-approved consolidated revision, 2026-10-18. Implementation remains held by #279.** Latest owner decisions in #278 supersede older proposals and historical comments. This approval authorizes backlog publication only; no implementation, owner-environment change, or provider run is dispatched.

Authority and complete owner decision record: #278. Current text supersedes older model proposals and historical scheduling/approval statements; comments remain historical evidence, not a competing current specification.

## Bounded change

Reconcile saves and publish confirmations

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Held saves/navigation cannot leave the list falsely stale; publish success refers to the exact stored revision and never implies newer unsaved edits were published.

- [ ] Verify save/list/publish revision reconciliation with delayed/held responses, including refusal paths; an old response must not replace a newer authored or published state.

## Verification

Controlled delayed responses plus real browser navigation/edit/publish; failed save/conflict cases remain explicit.

## Dependencies

- #281 — X-EDITOR
- #279 — implementation dispatch remains held.

## Scope limits

Only the described behavior and its necessary tests/contracts/docs.

## Delivery and closure

Approved plan; parked pending explicit dispatch. Proposed implementer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; independent reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh. QA scope: touched systems, including relevant positive, negative, concurrency, cancellation and restart cases. All tests use supported interfaces; retain existing coverage protections.

**Owner product acceptance required before closure.** PRs use Part of rather than auto-closing this issue until the owner has accepted the running behavior.

No implementation gate labels are applied now. After later dispatch, select the repository gate consistent with owner-review requirements; never combine aidlc-ready and human-in-the-loop.

## Source requirements

#156, #237

## Evidence provenance (not a new test result)

The observations below describe their original assessed baseline. They are not current solution requirements; the approved scope above controls. Reproduce on the accepted target before relying on them.

### Source #237 — historical evidence

Source links: [source 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c379f806ba8a04433779d98ded7e4196c9d4b663/apps/web/src/editor/EditorPage.tsx#L191), [source 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/c379f806ba8a04433779d98ded7e4196c9d4b663/apps/web/src/editor/EditorToolbar.tsx#L131)


## Consolidated source reports

- #156: Loop list can retain stale name and description after a saved draft edit.

These reports are closed as duplicate tracking records. Their accepted requirements and owner-review conditions remain in this bolt. This bolt is the sole open delivery record; no implementation or acceptance is claimed by consolidation.
